text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I catch sight of Symboli Rudolf
and
Narita Brian coaching some younger
students
down at the track.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...That is the long and short of it.
I would like
each of you to do your best to
maintain the form I've just taught you
and achieve the full potential of your leg
strength.

text_block_list.name: Younger Students
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Do I really need to be here?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... My textbook approach is boring
you to
death, I'm sure. However, this is
where you come
in.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Your attention, everyone. Next, I would
like you
to try and experience running
on pure instinct,
without a thought.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Brian here will act as your coach. Do
your best,
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Younger Students
text_block_list.text: Yes ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey. You do know that I don't know
anything
about coaching, right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that is perfectly all right. I would
like you to
do it in your own way.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Fine. But I'm not responsible for what
happens.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you lot... Just start out by running.
At full
speed.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh—I mean—okay! Is there anything we
should
keep in mind?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Forget about theory. I only want you to
think
about one thing—don't show me a
half-assed run.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Eek! R-roger that!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. I don't know the meaning of
going easy.
Got that, Rudolf?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Raaargh!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what the?! Brian's comin' at us like a
bat out
of hell!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong?! Run! Give it everything
you got!
It's do-or-die!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Eek! R-run away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The students scramble away from Narita
Brian, but to no avail. She runs them
down with ferocious speed, overtaking
them like a predator
swallowing its prey.

text_block_list.name: Younger Students
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Groan...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Tch. I knew this would happen.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Not to worry. It's quite all right.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, everyone. By a show of hands,
how
many of you ran according to the
theory I
explained earlier?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Precisely. Of course you couldn't. A real
race is utter pandemonium—a torrent of
animosity. In such a circumstance, one
would be hard-pressed to put theory
into practice.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In order for our labors to bear fruit, we
must first find the fighting spirit within
ourselves and be
resolute even in the
face of adversity.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Our fighting spirit? You mean like what
Brian just
showed us?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Just so. I had Brian kindly perform a 
demonstration so you could all
understand how important that is
first-hand within the confines of
training.

text_block_list.name: Younger Students
text_block_list.text: Wow! Thank you, Brian!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. Put it to good use.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
For crying out loud... Looks like you had
this all planned out from the beginning.
And the rest of
us are just dancing on
your strings.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm afraid I have no idea what you
mean. I merely wished to teach them
something of the
highest importance. In
other words...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You have to get their hearts racing to
get their
hearts in the race!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I'm outta here.
